teaser: What does it mean to fix everything but say little about why? You are a 6, the path called the nurturer, carrying the four letters of ISTP, the hands-on fixer who reads tools before words. The 6 wants you standing watch over the people you love, steady and present. ISTP wants a problem it can take apart, solve, set down, and walk away from. Crossed, you become the one who shows care by repairing the leaking tap at your mother's house without being asked, and says almost nothing about having done it.
